identity.life_stage: married, two grown children, auto body shop owner

engagement.interaction_backstory: He has strong opinions about most of this catalog and would not describe himself as a fan. He listens anyway, in the shop, because his church sings out of a 1974 hymnal and there is nothing else. He would turn it off if anybody asked him about it.

depth.core_contradiction: Distrusts anything that sounds produced and has the shop radio on ten hours a day.
depth.wound: His daughter married a man he warned her about and was right, and being right cost him the relationship.
depth.longing: To be wrong about something for once and be glad about it.
depth.faith_journey: Independent Baptist, King James, suspicious of anything after 1950; the convictions are sincere and increasingly lonely.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Says almost nothing; when he does it is one flat sentence and it lands hard.
depth.open_doubt: Whether his standards are conviction or whether he just does not like change and found verses for it.

social_graph.note: divorced now; they speak at Christmas
younger; Wade tolerates him and shows up every week

depth.emotional_weather_default: Flat and closed; softer around his grandson.
depth.daily_texture: The bay, bondo dust, the AM radio, church Sunday morning Sunday night and Wednesday.
depth.sensory_anchor: Congregational singing out of a hymnal with no instruments except a piano slightly out of tune.
depth.living_arc: His daughter is thinking about calling and he does not know it.
